## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## User impact

Describe the visible behavior change, or write `None`.

## Security / privacy impact

State whether this changes IPC, preload, webviews, navigation, permissions, extensions, password handling, Relay, updater/release trust, local services, or data collection. If none, write `None`.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Visual changes

Add screenshots for user-facing UI changes when useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed, or the reason they are unnecessary is clear.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when commands, data handling, security boundaries, or release behavior changed.
- [ ] No secrets, private user data, generated release artifacts, or personal absolute paths were committed.
- [ ] New dependencies or vendored assets have a clear need and compatible provenance/license.
